title: Duckling holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Duckling body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='16' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='11' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- Left wing holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(-20 34 58)'/>
  <!-- Right wing holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='58' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(20 66 58)'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50 52 C50 46 42 42 38 46 C34 50 36 56 50 66 C64 56 66 50 62 46 C58 42 50 46 50 52 Z' fill='#FF4757'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d='M46 48 C44 46 40 46 39 49' stroke='#FF8A94' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='3' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='39' r='3' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- Beak highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFB3B3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFB3B3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='86' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='86' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8C00'/>
</svg>
